function: Over-the-air reciprocity calibration for TDD mmWave massive MIMO: a double-CNN denoises the bi-directional channel estimate, then MetrNet and CaliNet output the RF-gain calibration coefficients (pp. 1, 4, 7).
system: TDD mmWave massive MIMO, two transceivers with 32-element half-wavelength ULAs, fully digital point-to-point link, RF gain mismatch; carrier frequency not stated; no RIS (pp. 3, 10).
method: Supervised CNNs: double-CNN (spatial plus angular) residual denoiser, then MetrNet encoder-decoder and CaliNet with auxiliary assisted-model loss; offline MSE training with SGD, no online update (pp. 5-9).
data_channel: Simulated extended Saleh-Valenzuela mmWave channels, 32x32 antennas, random RF gains (log-amplitude N(0,0.1), phase U(-pi/2,pi/2)); 3x10^4 training and 1x10^4 test realizations (pp. 3, 9-10).
test_conditions: Train on 3x10^4 and test on 10^4 independent realizations of one setup (32x32 ULAs), SNR in {-10,...,10} dB, random RF gains; no unseen scenario (pp. 9-10).
baselines: Non-learned: Argos, typical LS, dot-division calibration; LS and MMSE channel estimators. Learned: own single-CNN denoiser and CNN-enhanced calibration (ablations) only (pp. 10-11).
metrics: NMSE of calibration coefficients versus SNR; NMSE of channel estimation; calibration NMSE versus network depth and training epoch; loss landscape (pp. 10-12).
complexity: FLOPs order: double-CNN module O(NA^2 NB^2 NL1); calibration module O(NA^2 NB^2 NL2); total O(NA^2 NB^2 (NL1+NL2)), versus O((NA+NB)^3) for LS calibration (pp. 6, 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "we employ the extended Saleh-Valenzuela model to simulate the mmWave channel"; p. 3: "we adopt the extended Saleh-Valenzuela geometric model [28]". Custom simulator with a textbook model; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 9: "the testing data, collected independently from the offline model training phase, is unavailable in offline model training phase". Held-out part of the same simulator, one 32x32 configuration, SNR sweep only (Table III, p. 10); no unseen scenario.
q3_support: p. 10: "the CNN-enhanced calibration method with CNN structure, which is regarded as the ablation experiment for our designed double-CNN structure"; the other comparators are Argos [7], typical LS [6], [13] and dot-division (non-learned). No earlier learned calibration or estimation method is compared.
q4_support: p. 6: "We adopt the number of floating point operations (FLOPs) as the metric for computation complexity"; p. 9: total order O(NA^2 NB^2 (NL1+NL2)) versus O((NA+NB)^3) for the typical LS calibration.
q5_support: p. 9: "we employ the extended Saleh-Valenzuela model to simulate the mmWave channel". Data come from the authors' own simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public or measured dataset.
notes: Borderline function: the end goal is TDD reciprocity calibration (RF-gain calibration coefficients). Area 2 because the first learned module is channel estimation (denoising) of the bi-directional channel (p. 4, Fig. 5) and calibration serves CSI acquisition; reviewer to confirm calibration is in scope, otherwise exclude as function. The learned comparators (CNN, CNN-enhanced, no-supervision variant) are ablations of the proposed method (Fig. 2 caption, p. 5), so q3 is 0.
